verdict.rationale: Automated, headless access is a fair question for a company-registry e-services portal, which could offer programmatic filing or lookup interfaces, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no headless mode, API, or CI-usable interface. The only probes show both mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in returning HTTP 403 at robots.txt to an automated client, which points to automated access being blocked rather than supported.
